answer.reason: Several verses tell of events at the Euphrates, beyond the summary's mention of it as a river of Eden.

clauses.english: was where Jeremiah hid a girdle, found marred after many days
clauses.quote: the girdle was marred, it was profitable for nothing

clauses.english: was where Nebuchadrezzar smote the army of Pharaoh Necho
clauses.quote: which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote

clauses.english: had its water dried up when the sixth angel poured out his vial
clauses.quote: the water thereof was dried up

doubts: Verses that say only "the river" (GEN 31:21, EXO 23:31, 1KI 4:21, PSA 72:8, ISA 8:7 and others) may or may not mean the Euphrates; I left them out.
Verses that give the river as a boundary of the promised land (GEN 15:18, DEU 11:24, JOS 1:4) name no event at the river, so I did not use them.
JOS 24:2-3 speak of "the flood" (the other side of the river), which I did not treat as an event at the Euphrates.
